title: Null String Holography, Null Strings Probe Projective Boundary of Their Target Spaces
summary: We prove that the \textit{minimal null string theory} on a background manifold ${\mathcal M}$ is classically equivalent to the ILST theory on the projective boundary of $\mathcal M$, ${{\cal B}_{_{\text{P}}}}={\partial_{_{\text{P}}}\mathcal{M}}$. We conjecture that this equivalence also holds at quantum level, we dub this correspondence \textit{null string holography}.
